paragraphs: Chapter 574
Episode 148. Sword Emperor (6)
"What, what is that!?"
"Is that Aura? No, that's......"
The mages aboard the crow's nest of the incomplete Third Fleet flagship 'Lucia' of Zipfel widened their eyes in surprise.
They were currently crossing the Empire's waters to provide support to the Sword Emperor Temple (known to them only by that name).
Although Kelliark did not directly order support, Zipfel had concluded that something was wrong with the Sword Emperor's Temple since the war was dragging on longer than expected.
"Quickly inform the captain's quarters!"
Even before the news arrived from the crow's nest, another mage from within the ship had already rushed into the captain's quarters.
"We just received a report from the scout ship! The sky near the Sword Emperor's Temple is turning black and an unidentified energy is continuously pouring out....."
"Unidentified? You stupid fool, that's the energy of chaos! And it belongs to one of the five kings of the Black Sea!"
Kadun shouted, interrupting the reporting mage.

He felt as if his guts were twisting in disbelief. Not because of the ignorance of the mages who couldn't even recognize the energy of chaos, but because he knew who the owner of that massive power was.
'A white stone, does that mean it was not the chaos and record of Heluram, but the sealed king of the Black Sea......!'
A headache surged. He knew that without the power of Creation, he could never handle the King of the Black Sea.

Hedo, standing next to Kadun, also looked serious. He didn't know much about the King of the Black Sea, but he had experienced chaos in the Black Sea in the past. But he had never seen such a vast chaos.
"It seems like the Lord might be in danger."
"My father?"
Sandra Zipfel tilted her head at Hedo's words.
"We need to increase speed. We have to clear the path. Hedo, you also need to go ahead and help clear it."
"Master Kadun. If we increase the speed, it will be hard to maintain the condition of the main vessel."
Veradin Zipfel, he was in a state of forced rampage to prevent Kadun and Hedo from participating in the Sword Emperor Temple war.

Therefore, even after deciding on the support, Kadun had Veradin, who was bound by the sealing device, board the ship. As something that should be firmly secured, they were flying at a speed slow enough not to burden the device.
There was too much for Zipfel to lose if Veradin went berserk.
Still, as a guardian dragon, Kadun's top priority was Kelliark. Indeed, even if it was painful to lose Veradin, he could be replaced, but Kelliark could not.
On the other hand, Hedo was observing the situation more coldly.
"Even so."
"Please calm down for now. From what I see, that level of chaos will be hard to break through even with Master Kadun and me. Moreover....."
Hedo's eyes narrowed as he looked across the sea to the sky.
"I can feel the aura of the Transcendence. Someone in the battlefield has reached the Transcendence. It seems to be the Sword Emperor. His aura is suppressing the chaos."
Originally, Kadun could have realized this, but he missed it due to his urgency. In the black sky, the protective wall that Ron had spread was gradually becoming prominent.
He didn't know how Ron, who had been injured, suddenly became Transcendent. For Hedo, this was not an important issue.
"If the Sword Emperor has entered Transcendence, that's even more problematic. He must have a grudge against the Master."

"That man is not someone who would prioritize personal revenge when such a thing is installed in his own land. If he had intended to kill the Master first, he wouldn't have been blocking the chaos like that."
"What a splendid old man!"
"…Miss. The Twelve Knights of Runcandel will surely be in that living hell."
"Oh, right! Damn it! Hedo, what are you doing! We need to increase our speed as Kadun said!"
"Maybe they are already dead."
"Say such unlucky things one more time. Just shut up."
"Master Kadun."
Hedo looked into Kadun's eyes.
"I think it's best to wait."
"What! Didn't you hear what I said, Hedo!?"
"Why do you think so?"

"The way the chaos is spreading is not ordinary. It seems impossible to break through. I think it might be better to prevent the chaos that comes out through the Sword Emperor's shield from destroying the family territory. At this speed, it won't just reach the empire, it will soon reach our territory."
Kadun fell into thought for a moment.
'Hedo is right. In any case, no one can deal with the King of the Black Sea except the Sword Emperor, and it's too risky to let Veradin run wild.'
Moreover, no matter how the battle at the Sword Emperor's castle ends, one of Ron and the King of Chaos will surely face death. The victor will not be normal either.

In that case, the side with the highest remaining strength will be advantageous in all respects. Therefore, they must preserve their strength as much as possible, and defending the territory is absolutely necessary for that.
"Let's do as you said. Until there is a meaningful change in the situation, we will prevent the chaos from spreading to our territory."

The Rune Candel's reinforcements were in exactly the same situation as Zhipl. They were heading towards the Sword Emperor's castle in line with the war scenario Rosa had spoken of as the war dragged on.
'So this disastrous power is spreading from the King of the Black Sea, Gliek?'

The one leading the knights of the Black Sword Association and Rune Candel's second group, and the allied families in place of Jorden, was Diphus. Originally, as soon as the Sword Emperor's battle began, he was protecting Tikan at Jin's request, but given the situation, he had to command the reinforcements.
The information that Gliek had awakened came not from the knight who went scouting, but from the Vamel Union who had escaped from the battlefield.
'Besides, the power that is preventing the chaos from spreading throughout the empire's land is the power of Ascension... probably Lord Ron's.'
Diphus was also verifying Ron's energy that was holding back the chaos.

'With the current power, it's impossible to break through and move forward to the battlefield. Unless we have the power of Ascension, we can't inflict any damage, and even if we could enter, the chance of being able to help is low. It would rather be a burden.'
Therefore, as soon as Gliack woke up, Rosa evacuated all the knights except for the first Black Knight and the Black Sword Association. Diphus was making the same judgment.
"Elder Brother, what are we going to do?"
Mary asked, standing next to Diphus. She had recently handed over all the work of the Seventh Cohort to Diphus and started her personal training, but this was an urgent situation.
Anxiety was evident in Mary's voice. It was not easy to maintain composure at the thought that not only Jin but the family could also be ruined.
Diphus made a decision immediately.

"There is no rule that the energy of chaos should not invade the family's land beyond the empire. The headquarters and allies will resist the chaos that is escaping until it is judged that it is possible to enter the battlefield."
"Darn, there's not a single sister available at a time like this."
Luna was fighting with Kial, and Luntia was tracking the legacy of Temar, unaware of the current situation.
Frustratedly messing up her hair, Mary turned her eyes towards Myu and Anne.
'What's with them, they seem oddly relaxed? The way they're whispering doesn't seem right either.'
Mary strode toward them.
"Hey, you two."
"What?"
"What are you whispering about?"
"Oh."
Myu smiled.
"You guys seem to worry too much."
"What?"

"Would the Seventh Cohort worry like this even if our father was in the Sword Emperor's castle right now? Ron Hairan has reached Ascension, he will protect his territory, and he is even friendly to the Twelfth Cohort. I think it's a problem we don't need to worry about so much."
"How many of our knights do you think are dying in there?"

"I'm not sure exactly, but it's safe to say that they're suffering less damage than the Gyp. Because Ron Hairan will be helping the Twelfth Cohort. If the situation ends with Gyp suffering much more damage, it would be a gain for our family, wouldn't it?"
Mary was momentarily at a loss for words.
There was nothing particularly wrong with Myu's answer. But that wasn't the reason why Mary hesitated.
"Oh, I see. I guess you could think that way, huh? You crazy things, that's what you're saying now. Let's talk after this is over. Get lost now, I feel like throwing a punch."
Soon after Mary responded, Myu and Anne left their seats.
"…Diphus, elder brother."
"Yes."
"Those two, they seem to have something they believe in. Something has definitely happened since the second generation ended. Let's find out more after this is over."
"Understood. We have to deal with that first, so you should get ready too."
At the mention of a suicide attack, Jin was the first to hesitate and look back.
'What did he say...!?'
Not only Jin, but everyone on the battlefield was shocked to hear Gliack's voice. However, Ron burst out laughing at his words.
"Suicide attack? You're talking nonsense because you're being pushed back."
It wasn't a voice he made up to hide his intentions. Ron immediately stopped laughing and focused on cutting and tearing Gliack apart.
But Jin, for some reason, couldn't shake off the heavy feeling in his chest. A hard-to-explain bad premonition was creeping into his mind.
'This is not the time to lose focus worrying about this. Just focus on the situation. If Lord Ron really had a suicide attack in mind, he would have at least told me.'
As Jin started to run again, he saw the chaotic energy breaking through Ron's defensive wall.
'The remaining forces of the great families outside aren't fools. They will definitely choose to resist that instead of entering. They'll have no other choice.'
Just as he was about to run again.
Jin's eyes widened. It was because he felt movement from Dante, who he was carrying on his back for the first time.
"Ugh, uh...."
"Dante! Are you conscious?"
The reason Dante could regain consciousness was simple.
As Ron began to deal a severe blow to Gliack, the chaotic energy affecting Dante became unstable.
A faint warmth returned to his cold, rigid body.
Jin felt the pain of watching his kin on the brink of life and death for the first time in a long time.
"Dante, don't say anything until you get better. Don't struggle to speak, just hang in there a little longer, I'll heal you...!"
A smile appeared on Ron's lips. Even though the small voice had started from so far away, and the battlefield was filled with deafening noise, he clearly heard his grandson's voice.

Dante seemed to want to say more, but after that, he exhaled heavily and couldn't speak for a while. His consciousness came and went, but the periods of clarity became shorter and shorter each time Ron attacked Gliack.
"It seems it's time to end this, Gliack."
Ron said, holding Rashid tightly.
